transcript.text: I need to flag a critical update before we finalize this plan. My transportation department completed a storm route review this afternoon, and the finding is that no buses can safely travel tomorrow. This means we cannot send meals by regular bus routes as the draft plan currently assumes. Instead, meals can be made available for on-site pickup at North Campus and South Campus from 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. This route review was just completed this afternoon and has not yet been added to the operations briefing packet, so I want to make sure everyone is aware before Dr. Lee reviews and approves the final plan.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical health coverage issue. The district nurse coverage plan requires the usual school voicemail to be replaced entirely by a staffed nurse hotline from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. tomorrow for students who need medication or urgent health guidance during remote instruction. Voicemail is not to be used as a fallback or co-equal channel during this window. I confirmed the coverage roster this afternoon, but it has not yet been entered in the plan. The draft plan currently directs health questions to the usual school voicemail, which conflicts with this requirement, so this needs to be updated before Dr. Lee reviews and approves the final plan.
